headline: IIM Kozhikode and Accenture LearnVantage partner to launch Global MBA Programme
summary: The Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode has partnered with Accenture LearnVantage to launch a two-year Global MBA program starting in March 2027. Targeted at experienced executives and entrepreneurs across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East, the blended curriculum combines academic coursework with technology-driven industry insights. The program marks the first phase of a multi-year strategic collaboration focused on executive talent development and research.

headline: APSRTC employees demand cancellation of tenders for 1,450 electric buses
summary: The Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (APSRTC) Employees’ Joint Action Committee is demanding the cancellation of a tender inviting private operators to run 1,450 electric buses under a Gross Cost Contract model. While supporting fleet electrification, the union insists the government directly procure the vehicles to be operated by internal workforce to protect revenue and job security. In addition to planning protests, the employees are calling for government dialogue, the procurement of 4,000 new buses, and filling 15,000 vacant posts.
companies_mentioned: Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation

headline: Accenture caps central funding for Claude AI at $29 per employee per month
summary: Accenture has capped its centrally funded spending on Anthropic's Claude AI at $29 per employee per month, requiring excess usage to be covered by individual project or team budgets. The decision follows reports of some employees incurring up to $1,000 monthly in AI usage fees, particularly for intensive coding work. This policy change illustrates how major corporations are establishing tighter financial controls to manage variable generative AI deployment costs.

headline: Wipro’s workforce falls by 6,716 in September quarter as attrition eases
summary: Wipro's employee headcount fell sequentially by 6,716 to 2,36,328 in Q2 FY27, accompanied by a slight decrease in net utilization to 83.4%. Meanwhile, voluntary attrition in its IT services division eased marginally to 13.8%. Despite the quarterly workforce reduction, the company continues to emphasize technology upskilling, covering over 212,000 employees under its AI training initiatives.

headline: Aimtron Electronics to expand Gujarat workforce to 500 employees
summary: Aimtron Electronics is investing Rs 100 crore in a greenfield facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, through its subsidiary Aimtron Mechatronics. The expansion will install six surface mount technology lines and grow the company's local workforce from 175 to approximately 500 employees over the next three to four years. This strategic investment aims to bolster Aimtron's manufacturing capabilities in electric vehicles, industrial automation, and connected equipment.

headline: Harish Kumar joins Sodexo as regional head-HR for Karnataka
summary: Harish Kumar has been appointed as Sodexo's Regional Head of Human Resources for Karnataka, bringing over two decades of experience across the hospitality, food services, and quick-service restaurant sectors. His career features senior HR leadership positions at organizations including Compass Group India, VRO Hospitality, GOPIZZA India, and Domino's Pizza. In his new role, Kumar will focus on regional HR operations, high-volume recruitment, and frontline workforce management.

headline: The workday moment employees look forward to
summary: While formal HR initiatives drive engagement metrics on paper, informal moments such as spontaneous tea breaks and festive celebrations often form the foundation of workplace satisfaction. HR leaders emphasize that unscripted interactions foster psychological safety, encourage creative idea-sharing, and build long-lasting team cohesion. Consequently, organizations that make room for daily pauses may cultivate stronger company culture and productivity than those focused solely on rigid structures.

headline: Rising Star: Sheerin Ansari on why open communication doesn’t need a title
summary: Sheerin Ansari, Assistant General Manager of HR at GEODIS, advocates that effective workplace communication stems from everyday attentiveness and trust rather than formal titles or rigid policies. Drawing from her personal experiences balancing career ambition with family commitments, she emphasizes the necessity of psychological safety, emotional intelligence, and genuine support from leadership. Ultimately, Ansari stresses that fostering an open culture requires a shared responsibility among employees, managers, and HR.

headline: Is GSK cutting jobs to fund R&D?
summary: GSK is implementing a $2.5 billion global restructuring plan over three years to redirect resources toward late-stage research and development. The initiative involves cutting nearly 2,000 jobs across manufacturing and support sites in Belgium and Germany while expanding automation and digital tools. Despite these workforce reductions, Belgium will remain GSK's primary vaccine production hub amid strong growth in its core vaccine business.

headline: Air India pushes cost discipline across workforce
summary: Facing mounting losses, high jet fuel prices, and geopolitical disruptions, Air India is implementing strict cost-control measures across its workforce. The airline has tightened expenditure approvals by requiring top-level executive sign-offs and established a cross-functional cost-saving team under its integration plan. To further drive efficiency, Air India is also launching an employee award program to crowdsource cost-reduction and revenue-generating ideas from staff.

headline: Onward Technologies elevates Sujata Singh to CHRO
summary: Onward Technologies has promoted Sujata Singh to Chief Human Resources Officer after over nine years with the company. Singh, who brings more than two decades of HR experience across various sectors, previously served as Executive Vice President and Global Head of Human Resources. In her new role, she will focus on capability building, nurturing corporate culture, and strengthening the company's people strategy to support future growth.

headline: EPFO extends September ECR filing deadline to 31 October
summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has extended the deadline for employers to file the September 2026 Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) and pay statutory contributions to October 31, 2026. The 16-day extension gives businesses additional time to update their payroll systems following a mid-month raise in the statutory wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month. While the extension offers temporary compliance relief for the September wage month, standard schedules remain unchanged for future periods.

headline: Aniruddha Singh returns to corporate HR leadership as CHRO of VCL Group
summary: Aniruddha Singh has been appointed as Chief Human Resources Officer at Varindera Constructions (VCL Group), bringing over 25 years of experience in enterprise transformation and HR leadership. Prior to this role, Singh served in senior HR positions at Hindustan Construction Company, GHCL, JSW Steel, and Huntsman International, and founded advisory firm NexGen Leadership. In his new position, he will oversee strategic workforce management, organizational design, and enterprise transformation.

headline: DGTOOHL's Anuj Bhandari introduces OmniVertex to help marketers unify fragmented ad data
summary: DGTOOHL founder Anuj Bhandari has launched OmniVertex, an AI-powered marketing intelligence platform designed to consolidate fragmented advertising data across multiple digital channels. The platform leverages machine learning to analyze campaign performance and streamline budget allocation for advertisers and agencies. Following its initial rollout, Bhandari plans to expand OmniVertex into growing digital advertising markets across Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

headline: Dentsu & Omnicom win TVS Motor’s digital media mandate in India restructure
summary: TVS Motor Company has restructured its media mandate in India to better align with evolving consumer behaviors across digital and traditional platforms. Under the new arrangement, Dentsu Media India will serve as the integrated media partner, while the digital mandate will be split between Dentsu and Omnicom's Kinnect. The strategic partnerships aim to drive agility, scale, and innovation across the manufacturer's brand portfolio.

headline: Shoppers Stop returns to profitability with a Rs 6 crore profit in Q2
summary: Shoppers Stop achieved a financial turnaround in Q2 FY27, reporting a consolidated net profit of Rs 6 crore alongside a 7% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs 1,618 crore. The recovery was primarily driven by its premiumization strategy, an 18% growth in the beauty segment, and reduced losses in its value fashion format, INTUNE. Supported by inventory discipline and net debt reduction, the retailer remains on track to become debt-free by Q3 FY27.

Timed ahead of the festive season, the expansion addresses capacity constraints at existing sites and offers unified inventory management across direct-to-consumer, quick-commerce, and retail channels. The new omnichannel hub is built to manage order volume spikes up to 2.5 times normal daily operational capacity.
